rule.decision: Replace FINAL only if all macro metrics are non-worse, at least one improves, and per-sequence guards pass. Otherwise retain FINAL by continuity and report tradeoffs; never claim universal dominance.

rule.smaller_N: diagnostic, not used to change the primary decision
rule.secondary_Sim3: diagnostic only, not optimized for checkpoint selection

protocol.primary: D predicted + K calibrated + pose predicted; one GT median D scale per context applied to D and translation; canonical first-camera gauge; no global Sim3/ICP
protocol.secondary: one global point Sim3 on same valid correspondences; camera ATE/RPE uses a separate camera-center Sim3
protocol.RPE_interval: consecutive selected frames, delta=1 in sample positions; original-frame gaps vary with N
protocol.surfaces: CD mean unsquared bidirectional nearest-neighbour distances / 2; NC native normal consistency; no ICP
protocol.surface_availability: BEST/FINAL validation all five N; four models N50 all sequences; unavailable metrics remain N/D
protocol.macro: equal sequence weights, splits separate; missing metric yields N/D rather than dropping sequences
protocol.N1_camera: ATE/RPE and pairwise pose undefined, not zero
protocol.context_caveat: N changes selected frames and evaluated support, not a causal fixed-support capacity threshold

technical_integrity.scope: Exact resume tested for the retained runtime and schedule; no cross-hardware determinism guarantee. BEST800 has RNG but no AdamW state: inference-only export, not exact resume.

geometry_diagnostics.scope: GT substitutions and GT alignment are diagnostics, not deployable scores or causal attribution of training changes
geometry_diagnostics.limits: Coupled nonadditive errors. Sim3 global alignment sensitivity is not an additive global/residual error decomposition.

interpretation_limits: One seed and two held-out sequences from the same phantom; previously inspected, not newly blind.
Data, reproducibility and initializer differences are confounded: no unique causal attribution.
GT scale, Sim3 alignment and oracle swaps are diagnostic scoring aids, not GT-free clinical capability.
Historical encoder discrepancy origin unresolved; a new strict encoder does not retrospectively repair its provenance.
Failure of joint guards means tradeoffs, not proof that BEST is worse on every property.
